Hey! I love your work and wanted to suggest some feasible mod ideas Kevin being able to carry a flashlight, weapons or a bow, with more emotions, reactions and gestures. More player animations like dancing, sitting, lying down, smoking, kissing Virginia, cleaning weapons, etc. Torches and campfires should go out with rain or water and require manual relighting. A sanity system with fear, heavy breathing, insults in combat, plus realistic head bobbing and camera movement. It would add immersion.

data.message: Hey bro! I love your mods; I've already downloaded several. I just wanted to give you some ideas a DRUG MOD (growing/harvesting plants), a smoking mod with animations, sounds, and visual effects, Virginia using her bed to sleep, more interaction/dialogue between Kevin and Virginia, Kevin using weapons, more mutants/enemies/sounds on the island, and of course, more Virginia-focused mods.
